description: Free, local, no-payment health probe for one x402 endpoint. GETs the URL (retries once as POST with {} on a 405), then checks: is the response HTTP 402; does it carry a valid PAYMENT-REQUIRED envelope (Base64 JSON with numeric x402Version and a non-empty accepts[] where every entry has scheme/network/asset/payTo/amount), falling back to checking the body for an x402Version field; and does it also advertise MPP dual-stack via WWW-Authenticate: Payment. Grades A (valid envelope + MPP dual-stack), B (valid envelope only), C (402 but the envelope is missing or malformed), or F (not 402, unreachable, or serving paid content for free). Never sends a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE and cannot spend funds — this only inspects the challenge shape. Refuses non-http(s) URLs, localhost/.internal/.local hosts, private/reserved IPs, and ports outside 80/443/8080/8443; never follows redirects; caps the response body at 64KB; makes at most 2 requests.

url.description: The x402 endpoint URL to probe, e.g. https://api.example.com/paid-route

name: scan_endpoint
title: Scan one x402 endpoint for a well-formed 402 challenge
